description: This file defines API endpoints related to license management in the Mattermost server, including license addition, removal, retrieval, and trial license requests.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Represents the API handler with route initialization for license management.

methods.name: getClientLicense
methods.description: Handles retrieval of client license information, supporting different formats and permission checks.

methods.name: addLicense
methods.description: Handles uploading and saving a new license, including validation and cache invalidation for cloud instances.

methods.name: removeLicense
methods.description: Handles license removal, with permission checks.

methods.name: requestTrialLicense
methods.description: Processes requests for trial licenses, supporting legacy and new request formats.

methods.name: getLicenseLoadMetric
methods.description: Calculates and returns a license load metric based on active users.
